value.rationale: The sharp a/theta=1/2 boundary changes the full stationary modality of a physically natural sum of independent finite-speed harmonically filtered signals, strictly before each separate filter ceases to be U-shaped (at a/theta=1). It includes complete regime classification, an exact convexity invariant and a nontrivial critical valley distance; these are not a renaming or textbook corollary, and do not rely on speculative downstream gains.
